body: Flag: MIXED (MP Birla, litigation overhang) / MOSTLY-CLEAN (KK Birla companies). KK Birla group (after K.K. Birla d. 2008, split among daughters): Chambal Fertilisers (Saroj Poddar side; also Zuari Agro via Adventz), Avadh Sugar & Energy and Magadh Sugar (Nandini Nopany side; Upper Ganges/Oudh demerged 2015), HT Media (Shobhana Bhartia). Chambal is a cash-generative, dividend-paying fertiliser company; its 2025 buyback is a positive (unverified detail). HT Media has had persistent losses and complex RPTs with promoter-linked digital/radio entities -- minority value has eroded (unverified specifics). MP Birla group: Priyamvada Birla (d. Jul-2004) willed her estate, which controls Birla Corp, Universal Cables, Vindhya Telelinks, Birla Cable, to her CA R.S. Lodha; the Birla family (KK, BK, GP, SK, KM, Yashovardhan Birla) challenged the will. 20+ years of litigation: court-appointed administrators pendente lite (2012); a Calcutta HC division bench (Dec-2023) held that the estate is limited to shares she held, not controlling interests in companies -- appeal to the Supreme Court expected. Harsh Lodha has continued to run the companies. Lesson: a contested will over control can freeze strategic decisions and invite boardroom litigation for decades. Confidence: single-source for most KK Birla details.

data.red_flags: two-decade will dispute; HT Media losses/RPTs (unverified)
data.status_2026: Birla-Lodha litigation continuing (latest verified ruling Dec-2023)

title: KK Birla group (Chambal, Avadh/Magadh Sugar, HT Media) and MP Birla group (Birla Corp; Lodha estate dispute) — governance history

body: Flag: SEVERE (Mallya era); the current listed companies are now controlled by multinationals (United Spirits by Diageo, United Breweries by Heineken) and their recent governance is materially better. Mallya's Kingfisher Airlines (listed, grounded 2012) borrowed ~Rs 9,000 cr from a 17-bank SBI-led consortium backed by Mallya's personal guarantee and UB Holdings' corporate guarantee; he left India in Mar-2016 and was declared a fugitive economic offender (Jan-2019). Regulator findings: SEBI (Jan-2017) barred Mallya and six former United Spirits officials for diverting ~Rs 1,880 cr from USL to UB-group entities including Kingfisher; Diageo's internal inquiry (2015) had flagged the diversions; SEBI (Jul-2024) further barred him for 3 years for secretly trading group shares via FII Matterhorn Ventures. UK courts approved extradition (2020), but he remained in the UK per Aug-2026 reports; the Bombay HC in Aug-2026 urged parties to 'move on' as SBI's recovery of ~Rs 15,000 cr (incl. asset sales) took centre stage. Lesson: cross-guarantees and fund transfers from a cash-rich listed company (USL) to a loss-making sibling (Kingfisher) are the classic transmission channel; a strategic buyer (Diageo) later found and disclosed the diversions. Mallya denies wrongdoing.

data.flag: severe (historical); current UNITDSPR/UBL under MNC control
data.status_2026: extradition pending in UK; SBI recoveries ongoing
